title: Research nodule analysis (not a diagnosis)
safety: This result comes from a research model. It is not a diagnosis and it is not medical advice. A radiologist or a doctor must review the scan and decide on the next steps.
intro: The model looked at one lung nodule at position {position} in the CT series.
estimate: The model estimates a malignancy likelihood of {probability} for this nodule.
band.lower: This estimate is in the lower band of the model (below {low}).
band.intermediate: This estimate is in the intermediate band of the model (from {low} to below {high}).
band.higher: This estimate is in the higher band of the model ({high} or above).
band.not_assessed: The model did not give an estimate, because the input did not pass the checks.
size: The measured size of the nodule is about {diameter} mm.
limits: The model was tested on research data only. It can be wrong. It does not look at the rest of the scan, the medical history or earlier scans.
next: Talk with your doctor about this result. Do not change a treatment because of this report.
